notes.title: New track available!
notes.notes: A new track is now available. Currently only in summer day mode, so you will have some time to learn every corner of it before we release autumn and winter version (night), with all new entities to haunt your midnight tofu run! Stay tuned for amazing new content!

notes.title: New car added to the roster
notes.notes:
Hello Horror Drifters,
sorry for the long wait but we are working hard on stabilizing gameplay and creating new tracks. In the meantime, please enjoy this new car, you will definitely have some fun with it!

notes.title: Celebrating Italy-Japan friendship with amazing new car
notes.notes:
To celebrate friendship between Italy and Japan we offer you an historical italian car, which appeared on a very famous anime about the world's greatest thief ;) 

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Track and New Inclusion features to celebrate Spring
notes.notes:
Dear Horror Drifters,

We decided to make a substantial update to celebrate Spring.
First off, we added a new Winter Track. Yes, we are pushing towards Spring, but some entities are still on the loose and we need to drift away from them and into the Spring season. ;)
We also added a new inclusion feature: as some of our cars have strobing lights (currently just one, but others might be added in the future), we want to make sure players with photosensitivity are correctly informed. We decided to do so in the vehicle selection screen. In this way, you will not just get a generic warning at the beginning of the game, but a specific information regarding which vehicle could potentially be problematic, and still enjoy the rest of the game.

And tonight...I'll drive...

notes.title: Performance issues resolved
notes.notes:
Some players reported performance issues on Desktop (fans running too high) and on Laptop (stuttering).
We tracked down the problem to a performance issue related to lighting and we fixed it for all current tracks.

notes.title: Demo disabled as we dive deeper into early access model
notes.notes:
Since we are now deep into the early acces model, we will often be making changes that will tweak and enhance the driving model, cars, etc. 
Because of this, the demo we released  some time ago will not be a correct representation of the game.
We believe that mantaining both the demo and the full game at the same level of quality during the early access is not possible, so we have taken the decision to disable it.
Once the game will be out of early access, we might rebuild a demo version and put it back online.

Thank you for understanding,
Kurayami Yume Games.

notes.title: Driving model enhancement
notes.notes: Fixed Driving model: less slippery and stronger brakes.

notes.title: Demo update with enhanced driving model
notes.notes: Thanks to the overwhelming number of downloads during Steam Nextfest and Racing Fest we had the chance to listen to your feedback and we realized that the driving system needed some tweaking. This update on the demo is to prove that we properly listen to feedback and we are working to make the best game for our fans. Enjoy, keep reaching out for feedback and stay tuned!
